notes: v3.0.63 - Athena tab handling made robust: MLS now prefers the Athena tab whose Day view is actually rendered, re-checks a tab that was slow to answer instead of reporting no Athena tab while you are signed in, and treats a not-yet-rendered week strip as something to recover from rather than a failed day change. Every date, schedule and presence reply now also carries how many Athena tabs are open, so the app can advise keeping one. Reads only; nothing about writing changes. Everything from earlier releases remains. Requires Chrome 116+.
